name: Dangerous Cave
description:
Dangerous Cave

Value: 10000
Rarity: 100
Zone limit: 1

Dangerous Cave can generate on Dirt, Rough and Subterra. The bank is guarded by Behemots and Cyclops except for maximum size (5% chance) which is guarded by a variety of creatures.

Size 1: guarded by 4x1 Behemots and 2x3 Cyclops, gives 4k Gold, 4 Wood, 4 Ore, 4 Crystal and a Major Artifact (25%)
Size 2: guarded by 4x2 Behemots and 2x6 Cyclops, gives 8k Gold, 8 Wood, 8 Ore, 8 Crystal and a Major Artifact (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 4x3 Behemots and 2x9 Cyclops, gives 12k Gold, 12 Wood, 12 Ore, 12 Crystal and a Major Artifact (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 2x3 Behemots, 2x3 Ancient Behemots, 1x12 Cyclop Kings, 1x20 Ogre Archmages, gives 16k Gold, 16 Wood, 16 Ore, 16 Crystal, a Major Artifact and +3 Attack (5%)

Ogre Archmages have the same statistics as Ogre Mages and cast Mass Bloodlust in their first turn.
